title: Japan Chrysanthemum Dolls, Nakakuni Exhibit - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A striking photograph depicting a traditional Japanese kiku ningyō (chrysanthemum doll) exhibition scene. The figures' robes are elaborately crafted from living chrysanthemum blossoms, portraying the famous classical tale of Minamoto no Nakakuni (labeled '仲国' on the placard) and Lady Kogō from the Tale of the Heike. Nakakuni stands playing the flute beneath a rustic wooden structure with a painted landscape backdrop, while Lady Kogō sits gracefully nearby, capturing a quintessential autumn cultural tradition in pre-war Japan.
